customManagers.description: The Renovate version that validates renovate.json in CI and in nox -s renovate_check, e.g. npx --package renovate@44

packageRules.description: Lower bounds (runtime, build-system, extras, mypy hook deps) are raised by hand, only when the code needs it
Python versions for actions/setup-python change by hand, like the test matrix, noxfile.py and [tool.cibuildwheel]
Exactly pinned dev tools in the dev extra
Everything else: one PR for all minor and patch updates
A new Python for the sanitize job's container image is its own PR
ruff in the dev extra and in pre-commit must move together
mypy in the dev extra and in pre-commit must move together
